about: Background art for Play's feature graphic and the website's social image: base is every prompt, with {motif} replaced by one motif's words. The words, the icon and every letter are added afterwards by make_art.py (never drawn by the model).
base: Wide landscape background artwork for an audio games app's store banner. A deep navy blue atmosphere (#0B1430 shading to #16275E), calm, premium and simple, with high contrast. {motif} Keep the left 40% of the picture plain, dark navy with no detail at all (words go there later). No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no devices, no people, no faces, no frame, no border.

motifs.name: waves
motifs.prompt: Soft glowing golden (#FFD54F) and white sound waves flow gently across the right half, like audio waveforms drawn with light, with a few soft out-of-focus lights.
motifs.alt: golden sound waves flowing across a deep navy background

motifs.name: rings
motifs.prompt: Concentric golden (#FFD54F) rings of sound spread out from a point in the right third, fading as they grow, with a few tiny white sparkles.
motifs.alt: golden rings of sound spreading out across a deep navy background

motifs.name: night-sky
motifs.prompt: A quiet starry night sky with tiny white stars, and a glowing golden (#FFD54F) audio waveform running along the horizon in the right half.
motifs.alt: a starry navy night sky with a golden sound wave along the horizon

motifs.name: story-glow
motifs.prompt: A warm golden (#FFD54F) glow rises from the lower right like light from an open storybook, with gentle sound-wave ribbons of white light curling up into the navy.
motifs.alt: warm golden light and ribbons of sound rising into a deep navy background
